defs.def: to say that sb has done sth wrong or is guilty of sth 控告；控诉；谴责noun

ex.s: The following day, called to the headmaster’s office, I found myself accused of stealing the missing parts.
ex.t: 五年前我开始转向零浪费生活方式时就经历了这种情况，当时我和父母住在一起；现在我和丈夫一起生活时也继续经历这种情况，因为他并不像我一样完全零浪费。

ex.s: There was a huge debate about whether the reporter should be accused of (n., v.) on the star couple.
ex.t: 关于记者是否应该被指控（ n. ， v. ）这对明星夫妇存在巨大争议。

ex.s: Example John was accused of stealing money.
I was accused of the murder of a young man.
ex.t: 我被指控谋杀了一个年轻人。
